en: There's nothing like throwing your whole weight at a problem! Shall I teach one of your Pokémon Body Slam?
That's the spirit! Which Pokémon is to learn it?
A good Body Slam can leave the foe too stunned to move. Use it well!
Suit yourself. I'll be right here, sitting heavily.
An Egg has no weight to throw about yet. Hatch it first!
Hmm, that one hasn't got the build for Body Slam, I'm afraid.
{forgotten} isn't a move that can be given up like that.
